name: Blind
effect: Make a (P) roll. If successful all characters and vehicles within 15cm cannot make any actions for the remainder of the turn.

name: Smite
effect: Select a character or vehicle within line of sight and make a (P) roll. If successful, that character takes 1D10+5 damage. Target character may make an armour roll.

name: Terrify
effect: Select a character within line of sight and make a (P) roll. If successful that character must immediately retreat to the nearest table edge as if they had failed a break test.

name: Rend the earth
effect: Select a character within line of sight and make a (P) roll. If successful, all terrain within 20cm of that character counts as hazardous terrain for the remainder of the game.

name: Mind control
effect: Select a character within line of sight and make a (P) roll. If successful, the acting character may make one additional action with the chosen character. This action does not count as one of the target character's usual actions.

name: Wither
effect: Select a character within line of sight and make a (P) roll. If successful that character suffers -1D4 to their skills for 1D6 turns.

name: Flame
effect: Make a (P) roll. If successful, 1 character in line of sight suffers 1D8 damage. The affected character must use an action to extinguish the flame or suffer 1D4 damage for every turn they fail to do so. This damage cannot be stopped by armour.

name: Summon
effect: Select a character within line of sight and make a (P) roll. If successful you may place an exact duplicate of that character anywhere on the board and control them for the next 1D4 turns, after which they disappear. Characters attempting to cast this spell do so at -2(P).

name: Shield
effect: Select a friendly character anywhere on the tabletop and make a (P) roll. If successful the target character may not be targeted by ranged or melee attacks for the remainder of the turn.

name: Teleport
effect: Make a (P) roll and select any part of the playing area within line of sight. If successful you may move this character there immediately.

name: Dishearten
effect: Select a character within line of sight and make a (P) roll. If successful, that character now acts last in the next turn, regardless of their (A) score.

name: Immobilize
effect: Select a character within line of sight and make a (P) roll. If successful, that character may not move for 1D4 turns.
